title: Crayon
look: Waxy crayon that spills past a wobbly dark line, on twos.

doc.essence: A child's crayon drawing done by a skilled hand: wax texture, colour spilling past the line.
doc.notIt: Not pencil (colour, wax), not watercolor (opaque, textured).
doc.shapes: A dark crayon edge; an offset copy of the colour spills out a little.
doc.colour: Saturated +20 %; a lighter wax texture over each area.
pitfalls: The spill uses the body colour: very dark bodies spill dark.
